Because the vault stake is held until the gale settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the river audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 28% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
